title: Proof of the Riemann and Generalized Riemann Hypotheses
description:
We prove the Riemann hypothesis and the generalized Riemann hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions using the window energy of the Liouville function, whose growth exponent is twice the largest real part of a zeta zero. Each hypothesis is equivalent to one energy bound on a sparse sequence of windows, and that bound follows from a window theorem drawn from the Galois representations of CM fields. The Lindelöf hypothesis, the sharp Pólya–Vinogradov inequality, Vinogradov’s conjectures and cases of Chowla’s conjecture follow.

This record contains the paper (Paper/, 183 A4 pages) and its Lean 4 formalization.
